turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: Our average order value (EUR) was 130.28 EUR over Monday 21 to Sunday 27 September 2026 (seven days), computed as total revenue over non-cancelled orders divided by their count over the whole week.
